title: EvoMisty: Building, Optimizing, and Evolving Capabilities on a Social Robot
description:
arXiv:2611.31341v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Social robots face diverse and changing tasks in companionship and education. LLM-based methods can generate task programs, but they still rely on manually developed control interfaces and predefined capabilities.
